notes: חָכָם and כְּסִיל are recast as English possessives, so the phrase-initial *A* determines the possessor and joins the rectum's unit rather than the construct's (rule 29's possessive paragraph, including its indefinite-determiner sentence).
The second לְ takes only *at*: the parallel line gaps the copula and the ASV writes none there (rules 34, 49).
